sentences.text: Raju Bhunia vs Unknown on 14 August, 2024

Author: Soumen Sen
Bench: Soumen Sen
14.08.2024
 Sl No.41
Court No.29
 (gc)
 (Rejected)
 Crm (A) 2793 of 2024
 In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under section 438 of
 the Code of Criminal Procedure corresponding to Section 482 of
 the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 filed in
 connection with Daspur Police Station Case No.526 of 2023
 dated 21.09.2023 under Sections 498A/323/307 of the Indian
 Penal Code and Section 66E/67/67(A) of the Information
 Technology Act and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
 And
 In the matter of : Raju Bhunia
 - Petitioner.
 Mr. Amitabha Karmakar,
 Mr. Arup Kr. Bhowmick
 ....For the Petitioner.
 Mr. Saibal Bapuli, Ld. A.P.P.,
 Mr. Sayan Dev Kumar
 ... For the State.

1.
Heard the learned Counsel for the parties.
2. The main allegation is against the husband, the petitioner herein.

3. In view of the statement made in the F.I.R. read with the statement of the independent witnesses recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. directly implicating the petitioner of physical and mental torture as well as the uploading of obscene photographs and video of the wife in the Facebook and Whatsapp, , we are not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

4. Accordingly, the application for anticipatory bail is rejected.
5. All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
